units.source_text: 我躺倒在赤松树阴下的矮竹丛生的野地上，喘着粗气，以平静激烈的悸动。

en.t: I lay down on the wild ground overgrown with low bamboo grass beneath the shade of the red pines, gasping for breath, while my violent heartbeat gradually calmed.

units.source_text: 确实是左大文字山的山巅。

en.t: It was indeed the summit of Mount Hidari Daimonji.

units.source_text: 那是一座从正北面护卫着金阁的山。

en.t: It was the mountain that guarded the Golden Pavilion from due north.
